comparison: VCSEL r10 transistor re-evaluation at fixed frame efficiency 4096/4736
scope: Electrical transistor model with fixed hypothetical package and VCSEL graph response; all receiver variants are deterministic offline controls with separately trained delays. No device, PCB PHY or optical test.

screen.selection: Maximize min(worst training signed margin / 7.5 µAeq, min training one-sided time margin / 0.37 UI); earliest tie.
screen.note: Historical 100 ps at 3.7 GBd equals 0.37 UI; scaled requirement is a new deterministic diagnostic, not a timing specification or BER certification.

controls.actual_electrical: Conduction current transformed linearly, bypasses optical and RX.
controls.actual_graph_5GHzRX: Original published-figure shape proxy at 3 mA and original 5 GHz RX pole.
controls.actual_graph_25GHzRX: Original optical proxy plus hypothetical 25 GHz RX pole.
controls.actual_static_25GHzRX: Bypass optical dynamics but keep P-I nonlinearity and 25 GHz RX pole.
controls.actual_25GHzOpt_25GHzRX: Simulated conduction current with assumed 25 GHz optical pole and 25 GHz RX pole. Retains static P-I.
controls.ideal_graph_5GHzRX: Replace circuit/LED electrical response with ideal 3/7 mA current, same per-case ramp; original optical/RX.
controls.ideal_graph_25GHzRX: Ideal current control, original optical proxy, hypothetical 25 GHz RX pole.
controls.ideal_25GHzOpt_25GHzRX: Ideal current control, static P-I plus assumed 25 GHz optical pole and 25 GHz RX pole. Illustrative target, not matched to any actual 25 GHz part.
controls.ideal_static_25GHzRX: Ideal current control, no optical dynamics, 25 GHz RX pole.
